title: Eternal Light of Hessdalen

scenes.query: night sky over remote valley with lights
scenes.text: Why does the Hessdalen valley glow every summer night?

scenes.label: UFOs cause lights
scenes.query: silhouette of unidentified flying object over forest
scenes.text: Many claim the lights are UFOs or secret military drones.

scenes.label: Ionized air phenomenon
scenes.query: scientists measuring atmospheric gases in valley
scenes.text: Scientific studies link the glow to ionized air from mineral-rich groundwater venting under temperature inversions.

scenes.label: Geological cause
scenes.query: steam venting from rocky ground at dusk
scenes.text: Natural geology, not alien tech, fuels the nightly show.
Follow if you can't stop asking why.

description: The Hessdalen lights have puzzled observers for decades. Learn the leading scientific explanation behind the eerie glow.
